exposure: unawareness of the risks associated with infant formula feeding
cohort: The study included 656 mothers residing in Debre Berhan City, Ethiopia, with infants aged 0-6 months.
finding: The prevalence of infant formula feeding in Debre Berhan city was 39.7%, and factors significantly associated with it included having a female child, higher maternal education, specific maternal age categories (25-34, 35-45), primiparity, receiving breastfeeding advice, C-section delivery, late breastfeeding initiation, and unawareness of infant formula feeding risks.
mod_finding: Delivering via a C-section was strongly associated with infant formula feeding (AOR = 5.39, 95% CI: 2.54-11.42).
cross-section timing: 2023, among mothers with infants aged 0-6 months
